lines.port: @ A reversed sample that reaches its first sample asks for index -1 (r3 = 0xFFFFFFFF). The GBA bus ignores address bits 28-31, so a
@ logical shift (block 0x03FFFFFF) lands on ROM just before the sample; the ARM11 has no such mirror and aborts. The arithmetic shift
@ gives block -1, which is the address the GBA reads through its mirror (wav - 0x11, inside the sample pack). Same result for r3 >= 0.
